newsitem.title: USA: USF&G to acquire Titan for $234 million.
newsitem.headline: USF&G to acquire Titan for $234 million.

text.p: USF&G Corp. said Friday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Titan Holdings Inc. for $234 million, bolstering its position in two high-return speciality insurance markets.
USF&G said the aquisition of Titan, for a combination of cash and stock, would bolster its positions in nonstandard auto insurance and in coverage of medium-sized and smaller towns and counties.

Titan shareholders will receive $11.60 in cash and 0.46516 USF&G common shares for each Titan share, in a deal that values Titan at $23.20 per share. Titan closed Thursday at $22.875 in New York Stock Exchange trading.
The final price of the transaction, which also includes the assumption of Titan's debt, is subject to adjustment under a collar arrangement, the announcement said.
USF&G, which is based in Baltimore, said the acquisition was not expected to be material to the company's earnings in 1998, and would be increasingly accretive in the following years.
Titan, with assets of $405 million, is based in San Antonio, Texas.
